title: An ALMA survey of the brightest sub-millimetre sources in the SCUBA-2-COSMOS field
question: Using ALMA 870-um continuum maps of the brightest SCUBA-2 sources in COSMOS: what is the intrinsic bright-end 870-um number count, how much does blending/multiplicity affect single-dish sources, and what is the photometric redshift distribution of the brightest SMGs

data.angular_resolution: uv-tapered to synthesized beam FWHM ~0.8 arcsec; median beam 0.80 x 0.79 arcsec

what.value: S2COSMOS main source catalogue (183 sources, deboosted/deblended 850-um fluxes) used as the parent sample

evidence.quote: The final S2COSMOS main source catalogue contains 183 sources with deboosted/deblended
The COSMOS2015 catalogue (cite: Laigle16) includes 27-band, optical-to-near-infrared photometry
which contains deblended 24–160
we use the source catalogue presented by (cite: Smolcic17), which contains total flux densities for 10,830 sources

what.value: submm number counts used as input flux distribution for simulations

evidence.quote: is randomly sampled from the parameterised estimate of the sub- / millimetre counts presented by (cite: Hatsukade18)

what.value: Sersic index n = 1 and size distribution of 154 AS2UDS SMGs

evidence.quote: the median best-fit value for 154 of the brighter AS2UDS SMGs

what.value: literature 870-um counts (AS2UDS, ALESS) included in the Schechter fit

evidence.quote: from the AS2UDS and ALESS surveys (cite: Karim13; Stach18)

what.value: lens amplifications of AS2COS 0001.1 and 0001.2 (not corrected for)

evidence.quote: as estimated (cite: JimenezAndrade20)

recipe.method: CASA 5.1.1 standard pipeline calibration, visual inspection, concat per target; archival data re-calibrated the same way
key_parameters: phase calibrator J 0948+0022 on a 7 min cycle; flux and bandpass on J 1058+0133

recipe.method: tclean with Briggs weighting, Gaussian uv taper to common ~0.8 arcsec beam, two-step auto-masked clean
key_parameters: Briggs robust = 0.5
second clean: sources >= 4.25 sigma cleaned to 1 sigma with auto-masking
map sensitivity estimated by iterative sigma-clipping

recipe.method: SExtractor >2 sigma peaks in non-primary-beam-corrected maps, peak and aperture flux; significance cut set where inverted-map false detections reach zero
key_parameters: aperture diameter 1.5 x synthesized beam major-axis FWHM
within primary beam: peak > 4.8 sigma or aperture > 4.9 sigma
aperture-flux uncertainty from 100 random apertures on source-subtracted maps

recipe.goal: measure total flux densities and correct flux boosting
recipe.method: uv-plane fit of Sersic profiles with proFit + galario + lmfit; correction from simulated injections
key_parameters: five free parameters: R.A., Dec., flux density, half-light radius, axial ratio
optimisation repeated ten times from random starting values; lowest chi-square kept
boosting correction from running median of recovered/input flux vs detection significance

recipe.goal: estimate completeness of the ALMA survey
recipe.method: Monte Carlo injection of model sources with random sizes and fluxes into residual maps, then rerun detection and modelling
key_parameters: axial ratio uniform 0-1; half-light radius uniform 0.05-0.30 arcsec
assumptions: input fluxes sampled from the Hatsukade et al. counts with low flux cut-off 0.05 mJy

recipe.goal: compare ALMA and SCUBA-2 flux scales with end-to-end simulations
recipe.method: convolve ALMA model images with the SCUBA-2 beam; compare to observed and deboosted SCUBA-2 fluxes; 100 end-to-end S2COSMOS simulations to separate Eddington bias from line-of-sight multiplicity
key_parameters: emitters >= 0.05 mJy injected within 8.7 arcsec of recovered SCUBA-2 positions
assumptions: input counts model is the best-fit Schechter parameterisation (no clustering)

recipe.method: cross-match ALMA positions with COSMOS2015, HSC, IRAC (iraclean deblending), MIPS/PACS (super-deblended), SPIRE (prior-based deblending), VLA 3 GHz and Chandra catalogues
key_parameters: optical/near-IR matching radius 0.85 arcsec (false-match ~6.6 per cent)
3 GHz matching radius 1 arcsec

recipe.method: magphys energy-balance SED fitting to the multiwavelength photometry, median of redshift PDF
key_parameters: latest magphys version (Battisti et al.), optimised for high-redshift star-forming galaxies, fits redshift

recipe.goal: derive 870-um number counts and fit a Schechter function
recipe.method: completeness-corrected cumulative and differential counts over 1.6 deg^2; Schechter fit jointly to AS2COSMOS and literature ALMA counts
key_parameters: 10^4 catalogue realisations with fluxes perturbed by their uncertainties, combined with Poisson errors
assumptions: 1.2-mm ASAGAO counts converted to 870 um with a modified blackbody, beta = 1.8, T = 32 K, z = 2.6

recipe.goal: estimate cosmic variance in the counts
recipe.method: split AS2COSMOS + AS2UDS into 26 sub-regions of ~0.1 deg^2, combine into 0.1-0.8 deg^2 surveys, subtract Poisson and statistical variance, compare with galform
key_parameters: 10^3 Monte Carlo realisations per sub-field for the statistical uncertainty; Gehrels Poisson errors

recipe.goal: measure multiplicity and physical association of SMG pairs
recipe.method: count SCUBA-2 sources with two or more SMGs (S870 >= 1 mJy) in the ALMA primary beam; compare with the unclustered end-to-end simulation to infer the physically associated fraction
key_parameters: primary beam radius 8.7 arcsec
assumptions: simulation input has no clustering, so all simulated multiples are line-of-sight chance associations

recipe.goal: analyse serendipitous [CII] emission in AS2COS 0001.1 and 0001.2
recipe.method: taper cube to 0.4 arcsec beam, clean as for continuum, Gaussian fits per spaxel with adaptive binning for kinematic maps; infer association from velocity and projected separation versus a 10^13 Msun NFW halo
key_parameters: taper to 0.4 arcsec FWHM synthesized beam; median 1.0 mJy/beam per 32 MHz channel
adaptive binning to max 1.5 x beam FWHM until SNR > 5
assumptions: [CII] is the most likely line identification (later confirmed by CO(5-4) from another paper); lensing amplification not corrected
pairs in a ~10^13 Msun NFW halo have ~700 km/s velocity separation at ~20 kpc projected separation (following Wardlow et al.)

recipe.method: median magphys photometric redshifts for AS2COSMOS and combined AS2COSMOS+AS2UDS, gradient of z with S870

score_reason: ALMA continuum steps (pipeline, tclean robust 0.5, taper to ~0.8 arcsec, SExtractor thresholds, Sersic uv-fit) and counts/multiplicity numbers are given with numeric results, but the parent catalogue, tclean details, SED-fit settings and several simulation details are deferred to other papers.
rediscovery_reason: Archival projects are stated to be public and the continuum imaging, source extraction, flux fitting, counts and multiplicity recipe is largely complete with numeric answers; the SED/photo-z part is not self-contained.
